title: Section C SC-09: Telegram intake uses one global 5-second cooldown that silently drops other addresses, marks an address processed before routing succeeds, and keeps an unbounded set

evidence.note: COOLDOWN_MS = 5000, one value for all addresses
cooldown check, then lastProcessed and processedContracts.add BEFORE routing
routing by getCode; on failure everywhere the address is only logged
regex 0x + 40 hex matches any address in the text, including the bot's own alert texts if they are visible to the account

sibling_sites_checked: The whole handler (telegramListener.ts:71-128) read. Allowlist semantics are AUD-BUY-006; V3 alpha block 0 is AUD-BUY-017.
severity_rationale: S3: missed signals and a slow memory growth, no capital path. A second address within 5 s (same or another message) is skipped without being recorded, so it is lost; an address whose getCode routing fails on every chain (RPC blip) is already marked processed and is never retried.
recommendation: Rate-limit per address (not globally), record an address only after routing succeeded, and bound the set (TTL or LRU). Behaviour change in what gets bought, card BUY-06.
